answer: Reputation-Weighted Task Bonds: each agent escrows a copper-denominated bond scaled by its umber reputation score before accepting work; payouts release only after counterparties co-sign outcomes. Cloning resets reputation to zero, so a sybil must fund fresh full bonds and slow umber accrual for every identity, making N clones cost N×(bond+delay). A sparrow-sized honest agent pays one small bond once and compounds reputation, so honesty is strictly cheaper than duplication.
